pageDescription: Unified inbox for group chats and private messages: select a dialog on the left and reply on the right. New messages arrive in real time; sends route via the account task queue or direct Bot API.

list.sortDescTooltip: By last message time: newest first
list.sortAscTooltip: By last message time: oldest first
list.emptyFilteredDesc: Try another keyword or clear your filters.
list.emptyDesc: Group chats and private messages sync automatically once accounts sign in.

chat.emptySelectTitle: Select a dialog on the left
chat.emptySelectDesc: View message history, send replies, or generate AI drafts. New messages appear in real time.
chat.syncBotDisabledTooltip: Bot channel cannot backfill history: Telegram Bot API has no history endpoint
chat.syncBotDisabledShort: Bot channel does not support history sync
chat.syncTooltip: Queue a sync task to fetch cloud message history
chat.syncDrawerTooltip: Queue a task to sync message history for this dialog
chat.draftReadyTitle: AI draft inserted into the composer — click Send to deliver

chat.unreadBannerDesc: A divider marks the start of unread messages. Click it to mark as read.
chat.botChannelHint: Bot channel: sent directly via API; failure details appear above.
chat.userChannelHint: Account channel: queued as a send task for the leased Worker; abnormal accounts are rejected.

messages.resendErrorFallback: Failed to resend, please try again later
messages.draftGenerated: AI draft ready — click Send to deliver
